summary: Game.Core has no project references to Rendering, Audio, Net or Governance. Its deterministic SessionRuntime accepts host-supplied integer microseconds and product contracts, while clocks, workers and transports remain effect interpreters. Game.Harness builds on Core for fixed-step scripted/bot traces; Game.Render reaches upward through published Scene/KeyboardInput packages, and Box2D owns a mutable physics world behind its adapter. Core publishes a curated Fable source subset, not every .NET module; the curated list includes session/replay/planning/network/save primitives but excludes AreaTopology and native Box2D. Headless policy and correspondence evidence do not establish native gameplay, renderer performance or whole-assembly Fable compatibility.
title: Game separates simulation authority, harnesses and rendering adapters
